title: Registration FAQs — official Kenyan/East African portal (local fees, schedule, accommodation, AMREF cover, fundraising)
publisher: Lewa Safari Marathon (official .co.ke portal for Kenyan and East African entrants)
claims: Local entry fees: full marathon 42 km KSh 20,000; half marathon 21 km KSh 20,000; Executive 10 km KSh 50,000; Junior 5 km KSh 3,000.
The race is held on a Saturday; the 2026 FAQ lists race day 27 June with a start before 7:00 AM; registration is Friday 26 June from 9:00 AM.

Accommodation: self-catering camping KSh 3,500 per adult per night and KSh 1,750 per child per night; catered options include Maridadi Camp and Safaricom Village (Location Africa); accommodation booking deadline is 5 May.
AMREF medical evacuation cover is compulsory for local registration, subsidised at KSh 850; evacuation without cover can cost over USD 4,000 and must be paid before treatment or flight.
Kenyan and East African entrants do not carry a minimum fundraising requirement; international entrants do (GBP 1,750 minimum on the .com portal).
Runner change deadline is 20 May; after that, changes are handled on registration day before 2:00 PM at a KSh 5,000 surcharge.
Corporate teams run 4–9 teammates; corporate registration is for the half marathon, with full marathon and spectator entries addable.
